content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"==","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"==","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight-slime","priority":40,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"<=","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"swing-at-slime"}},{"id":"flee-slime","priority":30,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"<=","value":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"avoid-slime"}},{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":">=","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-to-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"go-to-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); if (p.x === 11 && p.y === 1) return; const r = await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'adjacent'); b.log('walkTo ladder: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!r.ok) { await b.walkTo(11, 2, 'stand'); } }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ok = (Math.abs(p.x - 11) + Math.abs(p.y - 1)) <= 1; return { ok, detail: 'player at ' + p.x + ',' + p.y }; }"},{"name":"swing-at-slime","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best = null; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x - p.x) + Math.abs(m.y - p.y); if (!best || d < best.d) best = { m, d }; } if (!best) return; const m = best.m; await b.selectSlot(0); await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); await b.wait(150); }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const near = ms.some(m => Math.abs(m.x - p.x) + Math.abs(m.y - p.y) <= 1); return { ok: !near, detail: 'monster adjacent: ' + near }; }"},{"name":"avoid-slime","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best = null; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x - p.x) + Math.abs(m.y - p.y); if (!best || d < best.d) best = { m, d }; } if (!best) return; const m = best.m; const dx = m.x > p.x ? -1 : 1; const dy = m.y > p.y ? -1 : 1; const tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, p.x + dx)); const ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, p.y + dy)); await b.walkTo(tx, ty, 'stand'); }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const near = ms.some(m => Math.abs(m.x - p.x) + Math.abs(m.y - p.y) <= 2); return { ok: !near, detail: 'nearest monster within 2: ' + near }; }"}]}
